The Real Problem
Why Most CAD Engineers Struggle
In Real Industry Projects
🎓

Software Taught, Not Industry

Colleges focus on CAD tools but skip how those tools apply to actual manufacturing environments and constraints.

🏭

No Manufacturable Design Exposure

Lack of practical experience designing parts that can actually be injection-moulded, assembled, and mass-produced.

🔧

Weak DFM Understanding

Design for Manufacturability (DFM) is rarely taught — yet it is the most critical skill on the factory floor and in product development.

📦

No Real Product Development Exposure

Engineers graduate without ever designing a product from brief to prototype, missing the entire development lifecycle.

Webinar Coverage
What You Will Learn
Plastics product design fundamentals for manufacturing
Injection moulding process & design guidelines
Design for Manufacturability (DFM) principles
Wall thickness, draft angles & gate design basics
Material selection for functional plastic parts
How industry product development actually works
Common design mistakes that cause mould failures
Career path: from CAD operator to Product Designer
